verdict.rationale: Crossmint is wallet and payments infrastructure (APIs for wallets, agent cards, checkouts). It is not an agent or tool-consuming host, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools does not fit this product type. The only related evidence is a docs query server for AI coding assistants, which is server-side documentation access, not MCP client capability, so it cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
